desc: Outcome of Board Meeting - Financial Results
attchmntText: Reliance Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

desc: General Updates - Acquisition of InSemi Technology
attchmntText: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding an agreement for acquisition of 100% stake in InSemi Technology Services, a leading semiconductor design services provider.

desc: Fund Raising - Issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures
attchmntText: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the approval of raising of funds via issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) on private placement basis up to Rs 15,000 crore.

desc: Change in Management - Resignation of CFO
attchmntText: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the resignation of Mr. Samir Seksaria as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel effective November 15, 2026.
Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding receipt of a warning letter from US FDA for its Dadra manufacturing facility following an inspection.

desc: Capital Expenditure - Setting up of new plant
attchmntText: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has approved capital expenditure of Rs 3,200 crore towards capacity expansion and commissioning of a new manufacturing facility in Gujarat.

desc: Declaration of Interim Dividend and Record Date
attchmntText: Titan Company Limited has declared an interim dividend of Rs 11.00 per equity share. The record date for the payment of dividend has been fixed as November 10, 2026.

desc: Corporate Action - Bonus Issue of Shares
attchmntText: Pidilite Industries Limited board has recommended a bonus issue of equity shares in the ratio of 1:1, subject to shareholder approval.

sm_name: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
attchmntText: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited informs the Exchange that CRISIL has reaffirmed its AAA/Stable credit rating on long term borrowing programmes.

sm_name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited
desc: Press Release - Major Commercial Contract Won
attchmntText: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited has released a press release regarding securing a new long-term commercial concession agreement at Gopalpur Port.

desc: Earnings Call - Transcript of Conference Call
attchmntText: ICICI Bank Limited has submitted the transcript of earnings call held on October 25, 2026 with analysts and investors discussing Q2 FY27 financial performance.

desc: Investor Meet - Schedule of Institutional Investor Meeting
attchmntText: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the schedule of one-on-one institutional investor meet with Fidelity Management in Mumbai on November 2, 2026.

desc: Insider Trading - Disclosures under SEBI (PIT) Regulations
attchmntText: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited has submitted disclosures under Regulation 7(2) of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations regarding disposal of shares by a designated person.

desc: Promoter Share Pledging - Disclosure under SAST Regulations
attchmntText: Axis Bank Limited has submitted disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations regarding release of pledge on equity shares.

desc: Shareholders Meeting - Proceedings of Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM)
attchmntText: Nestle India Limited has submitted the summary of proceedings of Extraordinary General Meeting of shareholders held on October 29, 2026 along with scrutinizer report.

desc: Postal Ballot - Voting Results and Scrutinizer Report
attchmntText: Reliance Industries Limited has submitted the voting results of postal ballot conducted via remote e-voting pursuant to Regulation 44 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations.

desc: Allotment of Equity Shares under ESOP Scheme
attchmntText: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has approved the allotment of 12,450 equity shares to eligible employees under the Employee Stock Option Scheme.
Zomato Limited informs the Exchange regarding reaching an operational milestone in quick commerce division.
